title: Ferrari Makes 69x More Profit Per Car Than Toyota
sentence: Ferrari shipped 13,640 cars in 2025, 112 fewer than in 2024, yet its operating profit rose 12% to €2.1 billion: about €155,000 per car, against roughly €2,200 per vehicle for Toyota, which sold 9.6 million.
source: Ferrari N.V., FY 2025 results press release (February 10, 2026): https://cdn.ferrari.com/cms/network/media/pdf/2026_02_10%20-%20Ferrari%20FY%202025%20Results%20Press%20Release.pdf
Toyota Motor Corporation, FY2026 (year to March 31, 2026) financial results presentation: https://global.toyota/pages/global_toyota/ir/financial-results/2026_4q_presentation_2_en.pdf
